title: Improve error messages with better context and helpful information

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## Summary

This PR improves several error messages across the codebase to make them more helpful and actionable for developers.

## Changes Made

### Multiplayer Module
- **File**: `modules/multiplayer/scene_replication_interface.cpp`
- **Change**: Replaced generic "This should never happen!" with actionable error message that explains the issue and asks for reproduction steps

### Core Translation System  
- **File**: `core/string/translation.cpp`
- **Change**: Added direct link to GNU gettext documentation for plural forms instead of asking users to search online

### Core Callable System
- **File**: `core/variant/callable.cpp`  
- **Change**: Improved error message to include usage guidance (check with `is_custom()` before calling `get_custom()`)

### Surface Tool
- **File**: `scene/resources/surface_tool.cpp`
- **Change**: Standardized error messages across all methods to use consistent, clear language

### Rendering Server
- **File**: `servers/rendering/rendering_server.cpp`
- **Change**: Enhanced surface version error with specific solution guidance (re-export from original source)

## Benefits

✅ **Better Developer Experience**: Error messages now provide actionable context instead of generic messages  
✅ **Consistent Language**: Standardized error message format across similar error types  
✅ **Documentation Links**: Added direct links to relevant documentation where helpful  
✅ **Solution Guidance**: Included specific steps to resolve issues where applicable  
✅ **No Functional Changes**: Only improves error messages without changing behavior

## Testing

- All changes are to error message strings only
- No functional code changes
- Error conditions remain the same, only messages are improved
- Tested that modified files compile without issues

This follows Godot's contribution guidelines for improving user experience without changing core functionality.
